title: REQ · Recover scans the store and resumes unfinished executions
summary: Recoverer.Recover lists executions and resumes only PENDING, RUNNING and RECOVERING ones.
description: Context: store.Store.List returns all executions sorted by ID. Desired behavior: Recoverer.Recover resumes every unfinished execution through an injected Resumer and skips finished or approval-pending ones. Expected result: a Result lists resumed IDs. Why: unfinished work continues after a restart.
acceptance_criteria: Given PENDING, RUNNING and RECOVERING executions, When Recover runs, Then Resumer.Resume is called once for each in ID order
Given COMPLETED, FAILED and AWAITING_APPROVAL executions, When Recover runs, Then Resume is not called for them and the store is not written
Given store.List returns an error, When Recover runs, Then Recover returns an error wrapping it and resumes nothing
technical_constraints: ExecutionStore interface must be satisfied by *store.Store
